name: Tuscania (Italy)
description: Swallow-tailed red flag with a white Nordic cross set towards the hoist.
history: Municipal flag of Tuscania, a comune in Lazio; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office. The arms and gonfalone were recognised by decree of the Head of Government on 12 July 1929.

features.role: off-centre cross set towards the hoist
